info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Webhooks-v1-spec
info.description: The Payments Webhook Retrieval API allows users to efficiently access and manage payment notifications from various transactions. This endpoint provides a list of payment webhooks, which serve as event-driven notifications triggered by payment activities. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and payment service providers looking to automate their transaction processing workflows. By utilizing this API, developers can ensure timely updates and streamline their payment handling processes.

get.description: This endpoint is used to retrieve data from the payment webhook, which allows you to receive updates about payment status and confirmations. Ensure proper handling of the data for seamless transaction management.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to retrieve data related to payment webhook events. It should contain metadata that informs the webhook system regarding the types of events being requested.

ListPaymentsPaymentsWebhooksRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET webhook operation related to payments. This may include structured data that the webhook sends upon being triggered.

ListPaymentsPaymentsWebhooksResponse_200.description: Response schema for a successful operation that returns payment webhook information.
